paragraphs.zh: zwei an einem gemeinsamen Kohlenstoffatom gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Kette aus der Gruppe  OCH2CH2O und OCH2CH2CH2O, wobei diese gegebenenfalls durch ein bis vier Methylgruppen substituiert ist, oder
paragraphs.en: two radicals R7 bonded to a common carbon atom form a chain from the group consisting of  OCH2CH2O and OCH2CH2CH2O, where this is optionally substituted by one to four methyl groups, or
paragraphs.notes: Page opens mid-claim: this is a continuation of the R7 definition begun on the preceding page, so the paragraph carries no printed marker of its own. R7 is printed as R with a superscript 7 and the chain formulae carry subscript 2 on each CH2; both transcribed inline. The double space after 'Gruppe' is as printed and has been preserved.

paragraphs.zh: zwei an direkt benachbarten Kohlenstoffatomen gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Bindung oder bilden mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen einen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Halogen, Alkyl, Alkylthio und Alkoxy substituierten 3- bis 6-gliedrigen Ring;
paragraphs.en: two radicals R7 bonded to directly adjacent carbon atoms form a bond or form, with the carbon atoms carrying them, a 3- to 6-membered ring optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of halogen, alkyl, alkylthio and alkoxy;
paragraphs.notes: The printed German 'mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen' mismatches singular article with plural noun. Transcribed exactly as printed, not corrected; the translation renders it literally.

paragraphs.zh: R8 und R9     unabhängig voneinander Alkyl, Alkenyl, Alkinyl, Halogenalkyl, gegebenenfalls substituiertes Aryl oder gegebenenfalls substituiertes Arylalkyl;
paragraphs.en: R8 and R9     independently of one another alkyl, alkenyl, alkynyl, haloalkyl, optionally substituted aryl or optionally substituted arylalkyl;
paragraphs.notes: Printed as R with superscript 8 and R with superscript 9; transcribed inline. German 'Alkinyl' rendered 'alkynyl' and 'Halogenalkyl' rendered 'haloalkyl' in the translation.

paragraphs.zh: R12     Wasserstoff, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxyalkyl, Formyl, Alkylcarbonyl, Alkoxycarbonyl, Alkylsulfonyl, Halogenalkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl oder Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxy, Halogenalkoxy, Halogen, Cyano und Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12     hydrogen, haloalkyl, alkoxyalkyl, formyl, alkylcarbonyl, alkoxycarbonyl, alkylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfonyl, benzoyl or phenylsulfonyl, where the two last-mentioned groups are optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of alkyl, haloalkyl, alkoxy, haloalkoxy, halogen, cyano and nitro;
paragraphs.notes: Printed as R with superscript 12; transcribed inline.

paragraphs.zh: L     eine gegebenenfalls durch ein bis vier gleiche oder verschiedene Reste R2 substituierte C1-C6-Alkylenkette;
paragraphs.en: L     a C1-C6-alkylene chain optionally substituted by one to four identical or different radicals R2;
paragraphs.notes: R2 is printed as R with a superscript 2; C1 and C6 are printed with subscript 1 and 6. Both transcribed inline.

paragraphs.zh: Y     eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, N-H, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Y     a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, N-H, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: R7 printed as superscript, the 2 of C(R7)2 as subscript. The closing semicolon sits at subscript height next to that 2 in the scan; read as a semicolon.

paragraphs.zh: Z     eine direkte Bindung, eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, S, SO2, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2 und
paragraphs.en: Z     a direct bond, a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, S, SO2, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2 and
paragraphs.notes: SO2 printed with subscript 2; the comma after it sits at subscript height in the scan and is read as a comma. R7 printed as superscript.
Closes the substituent list of the claim that began on an earlier page. The full stop ends that claim.

paragraphs.zh: 5.    Benzoylcyclohexandione nach einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 4,  worin
paragraphs.en: 5.    Benzoylcyclohexanediones according to any one of claims 1 to 4,  in which
paragraphs.notes: Start of claim 5. The double space before 'worin' is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: R1     Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenyloxy, Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinyloxy, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylthio, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenylthio, Halogen-(C3-C6)-
paragraphs.en: R1     halo-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenyloxy, halo-(C3-C6)-alkynyloxy, halo-(C1-C6)-alkylthio, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenylthio, halo-(C3-C6)-
paragraphs.notes: R1 printed as R with superscript 1; the carbon counts are printed as subscripts on C. The definition is cut off by the foot of the page in mid-term, after the trailing hyphen of 'Halogen-(C3-C6)-', and continues on the following page.

illegible: A small stray ink mark, roughly 4 mm wide and shaped like a squashed comma with a dot to its right, in the right half of the page in the blank line below 'durch ein bis vier Methylgruppen substituiert ist, oder', roughly level with the end of that line. It is a scan or photocopy artifact, not a character, and carries no readable content.
Two faint isolated specks in the left margin, one level with the third line of the page and one level with the 'w' line. Both are scan dirt, not text.
